subject: Application: Senior Product Manager - SaaS (Cortex)
opening: I am writing to apply for the Senior Product Manager role at Street Group. I have spent 15 years building and shipping technology products across blockchain infrastructure, developer platforms, and AI-augmented systems. My experience spans the full product lifecycle from discovery through to production operation, and I bring both the technical depth and commercial awareness this role requires.

proof_points.requirement: B2B/SaaS product strategy with measurable commercial impact
proof_points.evidence: At Neuroware I owned the product roadmap for a B2B blockchain infrastructure platform. Grew from proof-of-concept to production deployment across multiple enterprise clients, directly driving revenue through API subscriptions and managed infrastructure services.

Currently applying AI-augmented engineering methodology across all my work. Built autonomous agent orchestration systems (Researcher and Builder routines on cloud infrastructure) that manage multi-repository production pipelines. Shipped a complete game engine framework using LLM-augmented development at architecture quality in 16 days.

proof_points.requirement: Stakeholder management across engineering, design, data and leadership
proof_points.evidence: As CTO and CBO across multiple companies, I have operated as the bridge between technical teams and business leadership. At Oviato I worked directly with DraperVC investors, legal counsel, and distributed engineering teams simultaneously. At Neuroware I managed relationships with the Securities Commission Malaysia while coordinating a 12-person engineering team across three countries.

proof_points.requirement: Customer discovery and translating insights into priorities
proof_points.evidence: The Ordzaar product I prototyped became CakeDefi's fifth business vertical specifically because it was built from direct market observation of what NFT traders needed on Bitcoin. My protocol designs (DN-Key, Everstore) were adopted by regulated custody providers because I prioritised understanding their compliance constraints before writing code.

As a founder and solo technical leader, I operate with full autonomy by default. My recent Moddable project (535 commits, 16 days, four-layer architecture across six repositories) demonstrates the capacity to move at startup speed while maintaining production quality and strategic coherence.

body: What draws me to Street Group is the combination of AI-first product thinking within an established PropTech vertical. I understand the challenge of integrating AI capabilities into existing workflows without disrupting the value that customers already rely on. My experience building developer tools and platform infrastructure gives me a strong mental model for how AI workflows should be designed: as composable capabilities that augment human decision-making rather than replace it.
closing: I am UK-based in West Yorkshire, immediately available, and comfortable with hybrid working in Manchester. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my product leadership and AI integration experience could contribute to the Cortex product area.
